core_distinction.strategy_rag: RS is a global static technique bank, so the exact catalog and runtime stack must be identical across development and external evaluation.
core_distinction.personal_memory: MP/MS/ME are user- and time-specific functions of prior history. Exact item text must differ across users; invariance applies to the construction semantics, retrieval, candidate description, injection, and evaluation contracts rather than to one shared catalog.

formal_runtime.policy: g_c = P(material marginal benefit | visible_state, z_c, other-component background)
formal_runtime.off_meaning: Candidate discovery may occur locally, but no candidate from component c is injected into the generator.

same_across_internal_and_external: causal rule that only prior history may enter memory
MemoryItem wire schema and time semantics
retriever implementation, score, tie break, score floor, and top-k
allowed_to_change_naturally: number and age of prior memories
external feature distribution, subject to declared support and OOD handling

primary_transparent: candidate present after retrieval and filtering
minimum, median, and maximum session-relative age buckets; absolute age remains audit-only
top-1 relevance and top-1 versus top-2 score margin
forbidden: opaque memory ID as a predictive feature
raw memory text as a predictive feature
raw external dataset identity or split
future turns, related-session annotations, reference responses, judge outcomes, or needed_memory_sources
hidden evaluator stale, conflict, sensitive, or utility labels

shared_physical_store_rule.scientific_effect: A shared physical database with strict namespaces remains logically separate per-user catalogs and does not itself provide external-generalization evidence.

final_shared_runtime_repair.history_policy: Every internal and external state compiles all legitimate causal prior sessions for that same user. Internal histories naturally contain at most eight prior sessions; EvoEmo histories naturally contain 13 to 33.
scale_stable_model_features: retrieved fraction relative to frozen Top-k
minimum, median, and maximum age divided by current session index
bucketed lexical relevance and Top-1 versus Top-2 margin
final_shared_runtime_repair.remaining_limitation: Candidate-feature support does not prove that lexical Top-k retrieval remains semantically correct when external ME selects three items from a median catalog of 68 rather than nine. Diagnose retrieval only after the PM and thresholds are frozen.

effect_data_status.scope: The old 192 memory pairs use legacy two-item-per-source catalogs. In addition, 56 of the old 64 RS pairs were generated under those legacy memory backgrounds. Mixing old RS with repaired MP/MS/ME would therefore violate the one-stack treatment invariant. All old pairs are retained only as diagnostics; the formal 256-pair packet is rebuilt as 64 RS plus 192 memory pairs on the same repaired backend.
not_proven: that the current retriever selects the correct memory from large natural catalogs
that a source-only PM can distinguish useful from harmful candidates within RS, MP, MS, or ME
that the learned PM transports without abstention to all EvoEmo states
effect_data_status.reason: A limited candidate-conditional claim could reuse them, but the selected strong repair recompiles synthetic histories with the same memory builder used externally; formal MP/MS/ME pairs must therefore use candidates from that repaired compiler.

selected_internal_repair.name: evo_style_synthetic_longitudinal_recompile
construction: Order each existing synthetic user's nine cases by session_index.
Represent only the three existing user-specific stable preferences as atomic basic_info fields.
Keep the two globally identical compiler boundaries as system rules rather than misrepresenting them as personal memory.
Represent each earlier case as one prior session with its visible dialogue and an extractive session summary.
Call the exact same build_evo_memory compiler used by EvoEmo to create MP, MS, and ME.
Use all and only causal prior sessions for each current state, then run the same query, retriever, filter, top-k, descriptor, and injection stack.

replacement_blueprint.status_interpretation: Historical artifact status; its retain-64-RS clause is superseded by repaired_rs_generation below.

repaired_rs_generation.reason: Fifty-six old RS pairs contained legacy memory backgrounds; rebuilding all 64 avoids mixing resource mechanisms within the four-head training packet.

prepaid_generation_mimic_gate.candidate_support_population: external candidates that are present after the shared retriever; absent candidates close deterministically and do not enter the learned head
prepaid_generation_mimic_gate.failure_action: do not generate or train; repair the shared mechanism or internal development support and rerun the outcome-blind audit

report: unweighted end-to-end external quality, risk, and cost
in-support secondary analysis without using it for model selection

claim_boundary.allowed_if_internal_gates_pass: The PM learned a candidate-conditional component gate on held-out synthetic users under the frozen stack.
claim_boundary.allowed_if_external_transport_passes: The frozen gate showed limited development-informed transport to EvoEmo within its measured feature support.
not_allowed: PM learned to retrieve the correct memory item
PM generalizes to arbitrary memory stores
EvoEmo is a pristine untouched confirmatory test
claim_boundary.future_pristine_requirement: A new untouched longitudinal corpus or prospective deployment dataset frozen before inspecting its catalog or outcomes.
